enchantments.tooltip: Sea Attunement: While you are a Water Elemental, you gain bonuses to the caster level, spell power, and crit chance for your Cold spells.
Glaciation +142: Passive: +142 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Ice Lore +21: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Magical Efficiency 10%: You take a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.

Legendary Hruit's Influence: 3 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Positive Spell Power+6% Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Lightning and Positive Spell Crit Chance+3 Artifact bonus to Wisdom+3 Artifact bonus to Spell DCs
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
